title: Neurology and psychiatry clerkships
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
purpose: Practice neurology and psychiatry consults: acute stroke, seizures, headache and dizziness, weakness, delirium and dementia, agitation and capacity, depression and anxiety in primary care, psychosis and mania, withdrawal and overdose, and safety planning and the law on involuntary treatment.

weeks.8: Agitation and capacity in the hospital
weeks.9: Depression and anxiety in primary care
weeks.10: Acute care of psychosis and mania
weeks.11: Alcohol and drug withdrawal and overdose

blocks.deliverable: Score a stroke examination and decide on time-sensitive treatment.
Manage status epilepticus step by step.
Distinguish Guillain–Barré syndrome from myasthenic crisis.
Choose and monitor a first antidepressant.
Manage alcohol withdrawal with a symptom scale.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Consult notes: write two neurology and two psychiatry consult notes for supplied cases, each with clear recommendations.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
